technical_and_design_decisions: For U1 (alternative DLQ): Failed messages will be routed to the user-configured DLQ via a configurable error handler, with a custom MessagePostProcessor that injects headers for the original exception class name, exception message, and full stack trace before routing.

For U2 (DB change event streams): The feature will use a CDC (Change Data Capture) library (e.g., Debezium) as the underlying change capture mechanism, with a Spring Integration source module that converts CDC events to Spring Message<?> objects, supporting initial snapshot and incremental change modes for MySQL and PostgreSQL as the initial supported databases.

For U3 (Rabbit cluster HA/FT): Spring AMQP's existing CachingConnectionFactory will be extended to support a list of cluster nodes, with automatic failover for connections and consumers, and configurable HA policies for queue mirroring.

For U4 (Gemfire 8.1 sync): The Spring Data Gemfire dependency will be updated to the version compatible with Spring Data Gosling GA, with no changes to existing Gemfire module public APIs to maintain backward compatibility.

For U5 (colocated streams and leader election): Colocated stream modules will run in a single embedded servlet container (e.g., Tomcat, Undertow) with isolated classloaders for each module to prevent dependency conflicts. Leader election will use a shared external lock (e.g., database row, Redis key) to avoid split-brain scenarios.

For U6 and U7 (Spring Integration upgrades): Upgrades will be performed by updating the Spring Integration BOM version in the parent POM, with all breaking API changes resolved via adapter updates rather than modifying core SI code, to minimize maintenance overhead.

For U8 (Spring Boot 1.2.3 upgrade and dependency sync): The project parent POM will be updated to Spring Boot 1.2.3, with all specified dependency versions synced to the provided list, and any compatibility issues between Boot and other Spring subprojects resolved via dependency exclusions or code updates.
assumptions: All required third-party releases (Spring Data Gosling GA, Spring Integration milestone/GA releases, Gemfire 8.1) are publicly available and stable at the time of development.
An existing test suite covering core Spring (or Spring XD, as implied by U4/U5) functionality is available, reducing the need for full regression testing of unaffected modules.

The target environment for the increment supports JDK 8+ (compatible with Spring Boot 1.2.3 and the specified dependency versions) despite Spring Framework 6 requiring JDK 17+, as the increment is for a prior Spring major version line.
The project uses Apache Maven as the build tool, as implied by the Maven POM-style dependency version snippet provided in U8.
The messaging module (for U1) and existing stream deployment logic (for U5) are already present in the codebase, so no work is needed to build these base components from scratch.
The DB change stream feature (U2) only needs to support MySQL and PostgreSQL as the initial set of supported databases, with other databases to be added in future increments.

The leader election feature (U5) will use an existing shared resource (e.g., existing database, Redis instance) already in use by the project, so no new infrastructure is required for lock management.
Documentation for new and updated features is not a required deliverable for this increment, so no separate effort is allocated for documentation.
